question: after removing the draft E. coli, how much verbatim DNA does a held-out MG1655 window still share with the training corpus
why_sequence_keyed: removing a species is a NAME-keyed operation; a near-ortholog leak is a SEQUENCE-keyed fact. The representative manifest asserts the gate is stronger because no E. coli remains. That is true, and it is not the same claim as bounding residual verbatim overlap.

paired_drop.definition: committed minus representative, per window; positive = the removal CUT the share
paired_drop.why_increase_would_be_a_defect: the representative corpus is a verified subset, so no window can gain a longer match; a nonzero count here means the pairing or the subset check is wrong

published_committed_for_sanity.note: the published run's subsample is not recoverable from its artifact, so the committed arm here is a sanity check on the same population, NOT a bit-level reproduction

honest_limits: A longest-verbatim-substring statistic bounds EXACT shared DNA. A near-ortholog that diverges every few bases can carry real homology while scoring low here, so a fall to chance level bounds the verbatim leak and does NOT prove the absence of homology.
The default n=120 is a subsample of the held-out population, chosen to match the published figure's n rather than to be exhaustive.

THE_MEDIAN_FELL_EXACTLY_TO_CHANCE.reading: for the typical held-out MG1655 window the verbatim leak is GONE. The median share falls from 60.0 bp against the committed corpus to exactly the 15.0 bp chance level against the representative one.

THE_MAX_DID_NOT_AND_THE_FROZEN_THRESHOLD.reading: a SMALL, REAL residual survives. The addendum froze ~18.5 bp as the chance max at n=120 and named anything materially above it as the signature of surviving verbatim overlap. The observed 35 bp is 17.9 SD above that, so this is not a tail effect.
THE_MAX_DID_NOT_AND_THE_FROZEN_THRESHOLD.the_pre_registration_fired_in_the_DETECT: the addendum was written to stop a chance-level max being over-read as leakage. The opposite happened: the max exceeded chance decisively, so the same frozen threshold is what licenses calling the residual real. A threshold that can only excuse a number is not a threshold.

THE_RESIDUAL_IS_NOT_E_COLI.why: the representative corpus contains no E. coli at all, verified by the builder count check and by this probe refusing a non-subset. So the 19-35 bp still shared by four windows cannot be the removed draft; it is ordinary cross-species bacterial conservation in the remaining 17 genomes.
THE_RESIDUAL_IS_NOT_E_COLI.scale_in_context: 35 bp of 150, against the 94 bp median verbatim share the removed draft orthologs carried. The residual is a different and far smaller thing than what was removed.
THE_RESIDUAL_IS_NOT_E_COLI.not_claimed: this probe does not identify WHICH remaining genome supplies the residual, nor whether those four windows are conserved housekeeping promoters. That is a named, unrun diagnostic, not a conclusion.

THE_REMOVAL_IS_BIMODAL_WHICH_IS_THE_STRU.reading: a window either had a draft near-ortholog or it did not, with little in between. 77 of 120 had one and lost it outright, dropping from a median 94 bp verbatim share to the 15 bp chance level. The other 43 never had one and were already at chance, so removing the draft changed nothing for them. Zero windows increased, as a verified subset requires.

COMMITTED_ARM_VALIDATES_THE_IMPLEMENTATI.reading: the committed arm is a sanity check on a different subsample of the same population, and it passes on three independent counts: the published 55.0 median sits inside the bootstrap CI, the maximum is identical at 148, and the held-out population size reproduces the independently measured 3,906.

WHAT_THIS_DOES_AND_DOES_NOT_LICENSE: LICENSES: the representative corpus's name-keyed claim is now backed by a sequence-keyed measurement. Removing the draft E. coli closed the verbatim channel for 64% of held-out windows outright and brought the median to chance.

DOES NOT LICENSE: any statement about homology-mediated transfer. The companion froze that as channel two, measurable only by alignment identity and structurally invisible here. A median at chance bounds verbatim memorisation and says nothing about a 90%-identical homolog teaching the local statistics.

DOES NOT LICENSE: reading the model's cross-entropy result through this. The two are complementary instruments for two channels, and the companion's anti-misread clause stands -- a closed verbatim channel alongside a model much worse than +0.0054 would be coherent, not contradictory.
